_comment: Copy to config.json and edit for your project. This is the PUBLIC example with placeholder subject + reusable query groups (seeded from the thread-sweep themes). The real config.json is gitignored. Discovery is automated; posting is always a human gate (see the module README).

roles-architecture: system prompt per agent role duplication
dead-mans-switch: cron claude stopped running no error
credential-discipline: agent api keys env files leaked

reddit._caveat: DISCOVERY-ONLY and opt-in. Governed by the Reddit Data API terms; best-effort public JSON read for discovery only. NEVER automate posting. Reddit shadowban removals are INVISIBLE, so a posted-ledger entry for Reddit can be a lie — verify out-of-band before trusting it. Leave enabled=false unless you understand this.
